GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF COMMERCIAL TAXES
AUDIT CIRCLE-1.2, BENGALURU

Show Cause Notice under Section 73 of the CGST / KGST Act, 2017
Reference No: SCN/KA/2022-23/808
Date: 14-07-2022

To,
M/s Southern Infra Projects
GSTIN: 29MMMNN9012M1Z7
Financial Year: 2021-22

1. WHEREAS, comprehensive tax audit of books of accounts and returns filed by you for FY 2021-22 was conducted under Section 65 of the CGST Act 2017.

2. GROUND I - REVERSE CHARGE MECHANISM (RCM) LIABILITY: Audit reveals that freight charges paid to Goods Transport Agencies (GTA) amounting to Rs. 15,00,000/- were paid without discharging RCM tax liability under Section 9(3). The GTA suppliers did not exercise option to pay tax under forward charge. Reverse charge GST liability of Rs. 75,000/- remains unpaid.

3. GROUND II - GSTR-1 VS GSTR-3B OUTWARD TURNOVER DISCREPANCY: Outward taxable turnover declared in Form GSTR-1 exceeds taxable sales turnover reported in Form GSTR-3B by Rs. 6,66,667/-, resulting in short payment of tax amounting to Rs. 1,20,000/-.

4. ACCORDINGLY, Ground I demands RCM tax under Section 9(3), and Ground II demands tax on turnover mismatch under Section 37 read with Section 73.

5. NOW THEREFORE, you are called upon to show cause why:
(a) Total GST demand of Rs. 1,95,000/- (RCM Rs. 75,000/- + Outward Rs. 1,20,000/-) should not be recovered under Section 73(1);
(b) Interest under Section 50 should not be demanded;
(c) Penalty under Section 73(9) should not be levied.

6. File your reply within 30 days of service of this notice.
